moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: FIRST EXCHANGE
lines: That is the first exchange! {foe} sent out {foeMon} and {player} answered with {myMon}. Folks, this one is going to be a show.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FROM THE STANDS
lines: Did you see how {myMon} moved? I came to study {foe}, but I am watching {player} instead.

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: A RIVAL WATCHES
lines: So that is how {player} opens. Hmph. I have seen better. ...Okay, not much better.

moments.speaker: futureLeader
moments.title: A FUTURE FOE
lines: I will be facing the winner of this. {myMon} versus {foeMon}... I am taking notes on every move.

moments.speaker: futureOpponent
moments.title: NEXT IN THE BRACKET
lines: Whoever walks away from this meets me next. {foeMon} looks scary, but {myMon} has the nerve.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE HOST WATCHES
lines: {host}: Good opening. Let us see if you can hold that tempo against {foe}.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: LITTLE FAN
lines: Wow! {myMon} is so cool! Is it going to beat {foeMon}? It has to!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: LIVE FROM THE FIELD
lines: {foe} against {player}, {foeMon} against {myMon}! The odds board is flashing. Nobody in this stadium is sitting down.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: WHAT A HIT!
lines: That was a perfect read! {myMon} just hit {foeMon} right where it hurts!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: CRUSHING BLOW
lines: Incredible! {foeMon} is reeling! The crowd is on its feet for {player}!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: THE RIVAL FLINCHES
lines: Tch. That hit was clean. Do not let it go to your head, {player}.

moments.speaker: futureLeader
moments.title: TAKING NOTES
lines: That type matchup was no accident. I will have to watch out for that move.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: OUCH!
lines: {foeMon} hit {myMon} hard! Hang on, {player}!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE TIDE TURNS
lines: {foe} lands a huge hit! {myMon} is in trouble, and you can hear the stadium hold its breath.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: A WARNING
lines: {host}: That is what a real {foe} attack looks like. Respond or be swept.

moments.speaker: futureOpponent
moments.title: NOT GOOD
lines: If {foeMon} keeps hitting like that, I would rather face {player} later than {foe} now.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: HANGING ON!
lines: {myMon} is down to its last sliver and refuses to fall! Ladies and gentlemen, this is why we watch!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: DO NOT GIVE UP!
lines: Come on, {myMon}! {player} believes in you and so does every person in this stadium!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: GRUDGING RESPECT
lines: You are still standing? ...Good. I would hate for my rival to lose to anyone but me.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE HOST LEANS IN
lines: {host}: {myMon} should have fallen. It did not. That is the sort of heart this stage was built for.

moments.speaker: futureLeader
moments.title: SPIRIT
lines: I have seen leaders wobble at that kind of HP. {player} grips harder. Respect.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: FIRST BLOOD
lines: {player} takes the first knockout! {foe} will have to rethink everything.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: FIRST BLOOD FOR {FOE}
lines: {foe} draws first blood! {player} has to answer, and fast.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: UNSTOPPABLE
lines: Two in a row! {player} has a rhythm and {foe} cannot break it!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: LOOK AT THAT
lines: Another one down. ...Fine, {player}. You have my full attention now.

moments.speaker: futureOpponent
moments.title: ALARM BELLS
lines: That is a streak. If {player} reaches me, I will need my best plan.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: {FOE} ROLLS ON
lines: Back to back knockouts from {foe}! {player} is being pushed to the edge!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: THIS IS BAD
lines: They keep falling! Somebody, anybody, stop {foeMon}!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ODDS SHIFT
lines: {host}: {foe} has the momentum. Now we find out what {player} does under pressure.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: LAST ONE STANDING
lines: {player} is down to {myMon}! One Pokémon left and the whole stadium is on its feet!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: ALL IN
lines: It is all on {myMon} now! {player}, you can do this!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: I REMEMBER THIS
lines: Last Pokémon... that is exactly where I beat you before. Show me something different.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE HOST STANDS
lines: {host} rises from the champion's seat. "One Pokémon left. This is where legends are made."

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE ACE APPEARS
lines: {foe} is down to the final Pokémon! You can feel the pressure rise!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: ONE MORE!
lines: Just {foeMon} left! Bring it down, {player}!

moments.speaker: futureLeader
moments.title: THE ACE
lines: {foe} always keeps the best for last. I have seen what {foeMon} can do. Be careful.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: A DEEP BREATH
lines: {host}: {foe}'s final Pokémon is the one they trust most. Every great battle comes down to this.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE BAND GLOWS
lines: {myMon} Dynamaxes! The whole stadium is shaking! Can anything stand against that?!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: HUGE!
lines: {myMon} is giant! I felt that in my feet!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: {FOE} GOES BIG
lines: {foe} Dynamaxes {foeMon}! This is the Galar way, and the roar is deafening!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE ANSWER
lines: {host}: Dynamax is a pressure test. Find the opening and strike, {player}.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: NO WAY
lines: That is enormous! Is {player} going to be okay?!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: HALFTIME BUZZ
lines: Turn after turn and nobody blinks! {player} and {foe} are putting on the best match of the season!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: EDGE OF MY SEAT
lines: I cannot look! ...Okay I can look. Go {player}!

moments.speaker: futureOpponent
moments.title: SCOUTING REPORT
lines: {foe} has that switch pattern, {player} reads it every time. This is a battle of minds.

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: HOLD ON
lines: I came to see you lose and I am running out of excuses. Keep going.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: A MARATHON
lines: This one is going long! The stadium clock is ticking and nobody is leaving their seat!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE HOST CHECKS THE CLOCK
lines: {host}: Slow and steady. The longer it goes, the more the crowd decides.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE CROWD TURNS
lines: Listen to that! The whole stadium is chanting for {player}! The favour has swung their way!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: WE ARE WITH YOU
lines: {player}! {player}! {player}! The whole stadium is behind you now!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE CROWD SHIFTS
lines: The mood changes! The stadium leans toward {foe}. {player} will have to win them back.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: UNDERDOG TIME
lines: The crowd is on {foe}'s side now... but I love an underdog, {player}!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: DEAD EVEN
lines: The favour bar is dead even! This stadium cannot decide who to cheer, and neither can I!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: EVEN GROUND
lines: {host}: A match like this is rare. Savour it.

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: FINISH IT!
lines: {foeMon} is nearly out! Do not let it breathe, {player}!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: ON THE ROPES
lines: {foeMon} is on the ropes! One more clean hit and this one is over!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION SPEAKS
lines: {host}: This is a final. No holding back, no safety net. Give the crowd your absolute best.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION GRINS
lines: {host}: There it is. The last Pokémon. Now we will see what you are really made of.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE CHAMPION IS IMPRESSED
lines: {host}: Still on your feet? I expected nothing less. But I am not done yet.

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: ONE LAST POKÉMON!
lines: {foe} is not done! "I refuse to lose here! Go, {foeMon}!"

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: PURE BOND!
lines: The bond between {foe} and {foeMon} is pure! It surges with Mega Evolution power!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: TRANSFORMATION!
lines: {myMon} transforms! That kind of power on this stage is something special!

moments.speaker: crowdTrainer
moments.title: THEY CHANT YOUR NAME
lines: Everyone is chanting for {player}! The stands are shaking!

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE UNDERDOG
lines: {player} is down on numbers but not on spirit! The stadium loves an underdog!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: THE HOST SMILES
lines: {host}: Down on Pokémon and still fighting. That is what a challenger looks like.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: CLEAN SWEEP
lines: Three knockouts in a row! {player} is sweeping {foe} off the field!

moments.speaker: host
moments.title: FLAWLESS
lines: {host}: Not one of your Pokémon has fallen. That is a performance people will talk about for years.

moments.speaker: reporter
moments.title: THE SWEEP
lines: {foe} has taken three! The stadium is in shock!

moments.speaker: rival
moments.title: AN UNEXPECTED CHEER
lines: Do not get used to it, but... go, {player}!

moments.speaker: futureLeader
moments.title: THAT MOVE!
lines: A hit like that would shake even my team. {player} is the real thing.

moments.speaker: futureOpponent
moments.title: WORRIED GLANCE
lines: Two knockouts for {foe}. I hope I do not meet them in the next round.
